messages:
lee-sales: Heads-up, MediCareX POC signs today. They requested a single-page appendix for SOW: recommended reserved GPU commit, autoscale settings, and a short monthly cost estimate. Traffic: short spikes to ~1k RPS (1-3m), 95th ~700 RPS, avg ~65 tokens/req. HIPAA required (Private). Any quick recs?

marco-eng: quick calc: 1k*65 = 65k tok/s peak. Our redwood-3-medium quantized perf ~13k tok/s per GPU under target latencies -> baseline peak need ~5 GPUs (65k/13k=5). For steady 95th (~700) we’d need ~3-4 GPUs.

anya-ml: if they accept quantized+KV caching we see effective +20% throughput/GPU, so 4 GPUs could handle most peaks with preheat. If full precision required add ~30% capacity -> plan 7 GPUs.

marco-eng: ops proposal for SOW: Option 1 (Conservative): reserve 6 GPUs, autoscale 6->9, AZ spread 3-way. Option 2 (Cost-opt): reserve 4 GPUs, autoscale 4->9 with burst credits and mandatory preheat KV warmup.

sam-security: HIPAA notes: Private only; customer-managed KMS required; signed BAA; avoid spot for reserved pool. Document AZ spread and eviction-tolerance options in appendix.

ops-olivia: I'll own the runbook. Suggested autoscale policy: min_reserved = quoted commit, max = 9, scale-up trigger = sustained queue growth >20% for 20s OR p95 > SLA, cool-down 3m. Preheat: KV warmup + kernel bake for seq_len 512 + 10m smoke.

finance-bot: internal rates (internal only): reserved GPU = $3.15/hr. Monthly examples (30d): Option 1 (6 GPUs) = 6*24*30*3.15 = $13,608/mo base. Option 2 (4 GPUs) = $9,072/mo base + burst spend variable. I'll drop a simple one-pager in the deal folder.

lee-sales: perfect. Can we get a one-pager by EOD to attach to SOW and legal? Also need a short line on acceptance criteria for preheat smoke.

ops-olivia: acceptance: p95 latency within SLA and token/s >= expected baseline after 10m preheat. I'll add that to the appendix.

marco-eng: minor note: cold-start kernel warmup can add ~200-400ms tail latency; include mandatory preheat as onboarding milestone.

scheduler-bot: Smoke test slot booked: 2024-06-12T09:00Z -> /infra/smoke-tests/1799998888. Assigned: @marco-eng.

lee-sales: Thanks team  I'll attach both options and security bullets to SOW. If preheat results look good we can recommend Option 2 to the customer.
